faqs.q: Sec. 26-2. - Review and update of emergency operations plan (basic plan).
faqs.a:
The city manager and the community resilience coordinator shall annually review the
               emergency operations plan (basic plan) and update the document as necessary to ensure
               that the plan enables the timely and effective use of all available city resources
               to plan for, respond to and recover from civil emergencies, emergencies, or local
               disasters, whether natural or manmade, that are likely to affect the health, security,
               safety, or property of the inhabitants of the city.
(
Ord. No. 4827
, § 1, 12-5-2022)
